summary: Frontend-only validation of Meteosat MSG smooth-blur fix (iteration_23). Verified on DESKTOP (1920x800) and MOBILE (412x915) that the .meteosat-smooth-tile container has computed CSS `filter: blur(30px)` strictly, with no contrast/brightness/saturate/transform. Cloud layer toggle ON/OFF works, banner shows '10.8 µm' (with proper µ char), no console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: App.css rule .meteosat-smooth-tile correctly contains ONLY `filter: blur(30px)` plus image-rendering hints — strictly matches spec (no contrast/brightness/saturate/transform).
Note: the .leaflet-zoom-anim override on line 28-30 also uses blur(30px) — consistent. No spec deviation found.
WeatherLayers.jsx ligne 307 utilise bien 10.8 µm — confirmé rendu correct sur mobile (pas de MM).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Meteosat blur(30px) fix is fully validated. Desktop+Mobile both show: computed filter=blur(30px), transform=none, opacity=0.7. No pixelated grid visible in screenshots — appears as continuous diffuse gradient. CARTO basemap (Tarbes/Lourdes labels) still readable through 0.7 opacity. Storm cell markers (red/orange/green circles) clearly visible above cloud layer. 10.8 µm character renders correctly on both viewports (mobile drawer panel + desktop floating panel). Zero console errors during toggle ON/OFF cycles. Test selector: `div.meteosat-smooth-tile` works (className applied on Leaflet layer container, not img).
